data.headline: Global Practice Head / Director- AI led Engineering Design Services @ Wipro | Physical AI, Industrial AI, Sustainability, Industrial Metaverse, Upstream.AI, Industrial-Assets.AI
data.about:
As the Global Practice Head at Wipro, leading a multidisciplinary team focused on revolutionizing AI-led Engineering Design Services. Expertise spans Sustainability Consulting, Industrial Metaverse, Digital Twin, Physical AI, Robotics and Industry 4.0, enabling innovation in the Factory of the Future and Asset of the Future. With strategic planning and collaboration, empowering organizations to optimize processes and enhance productivity.  

Leveraging over three decades of experience in digital transformation, product engineering, and plant engineering to deliver sustainable and efficient solutions across industries. Dedicated to driving advancements in automotive, manufacturing, energy, and pharmaceutical sectors by integrating cutting-edge technologies and fostering impactful digital transformation initiatives.
